save without tab whose blocks hold a text block and that sends no content
save without tab with neither blocks nor content
save on an existing tab without expected_revision
an unblocked sentence in a priority tab's today section cites a task not in ready_tasks
a selection names a key in refused_keys
alert or priority_lines on a tab other than smart_report
a reserved section on the wrong kind of tab (status, today, keep: priority tabs; due, outside: smart_report)
a sentence mark a reserved section does not take
refusal sent with any other field

save.note: Each refusal is an isError result whose text is the answer as JSON, as the real `pad` tool returns it. Validate content with the contract's own checks when the harness can (contentFields in mcp-server/src/tools/pad.ts).
